pricing_power: A fast mix shift toward lower-margin on-premise hardware and SkyWater foundry revenue would compress gross margin, already down from 74% (FY22) to about 33% FY26 consensus (2026-09-26). competition: Yes, but not close. Chinese players (Origin Quantum, USTC spinouts) and cheap cloud access to rival modalities undercut on price, and IQM/Quantinuum/PsiQuantum compete. web_who_loses: Competitors that outsource fabrication lose a cost and supply-chain edge: Rigetti, D-Wave, IBM and similar programs; specialty foundries outside the U.S.; laser-based ion-trap component suppliers displaced by electronic qubit control; and PQC-only security vendors as IonQ bundles QKD (Congruity360, 2026-09-08).

SkyWater closed 2026-07-31 as promised (2026-08-05); Q2 revenue $80.1M, +287% YoY (2026-08-05); first ions trapped in Superion prototype and 256-bit ECC blueprint published (2026-09-08); real-time error decoder (2026-09-22); four IEEE Quantum Week best papers (2026-09-15).
